head: Chord Lab turns your iPhone into a chord instrument with a joystick
dek: Chord Lab gives you seven chord keys and a joystick to play chords, strums and arpeggios with 110 sounds. It was #11 among paid Music apps on the US App Store on 10 November.
details: You can build your own chord shapes, chain up to six of 15 effects and play along with 40 rhythms. It costs $4.99 with in-app purchases, by Daniel Albano, and needs iOS 16.6.
means: You can play full chords without knowing a keyboard or guitar.
todo: Find Chord Lab in the App Store.
